sources.title: AtomicChat/FLUX-3-Image-Klein-GGUF · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: FLUX 3 Image Klein is Black Forest Labs' 5.6B text-to-image and editing model: one model for generation, single-reference edits and up to ten reference images, distilled to 16 steps at CFG 1. This repo has the image model as GGUF for stable-diffusion.cpp, with the text encoder and the autoencoder next to it.

sources.snippet: FLUX.3 Image Klein (Black Forest Labs, 5.6B, 16 steps at CFG 1) is published as GGUF for stable-diffusion.cpp at AtomicChat/FLUX-3-Image-Klein-GGUF: the diffusion model, the Qwen3-VL-4B text encoder and the FLUX.2 VAE in one repo. Its AD files are measured closer to the original than unsloth's at the same size (card, "How these compare"). The catalog entry is ready as a draft in AtomicBot-ai ...

sources.snippet: FLUX 3 Image Klein Model page • Weights • Demo This repository contains the reference inference code for FLUX 3 Image Klein, the 5.6B open weights image model from Black Forest Labs: text-to-image, editing with up to 10 reference images, and layout control with bounding boxes, through one model.
